name: Raven Queen
slug: The Raven Queen is an elder god of death, also called Nira, who once walked among mortals and can take a harpy-like form.
description: Raven Queen, also known as Nira, is an elder god associated with death and the dead. She has a regal humanoid appearance, typically wearing a dark flowing robe and a blank white porcelain mask, and can transform into a harpy-like form with enormous black wings. She was once more mortal and has personally walked among mortals, giving her a perspective that distinguishes her from more distant divine beings. She is closely connected to an order of talons, including Sylan, whom she recognizes as a servant of her order rather than a butcher. Raven Queen treats death as a serious and immutable force, encouraging mortals to make their lives and eventual deaths meaningful rather than attempting to defy death.

log.summary: During the ceremony, the Raven Queen observed the party before approaching them after the other gods departed. She appeared in a regal humanoid form wearing a dark flowing robe and blank white porcelain mask, and revealed that she had once been more mortal and had personally walked among mortals. She recognized Sylan and Dana from the Everfalls and expressed surprise at how impressed she was by the party’s accomplishments. She offered to guide the party where they needed to go, provided they did not waste her time or turn the journey into a fool’s errand. She warned that death was not something to be treated lightly and suggested that some members of the party had limited chances or lives remaining. Rather than defying death, she urged them to make their lives and eventual deaths meaningful. She also recognized Sylan as a talon of her order rather than a butcher, advising him to preserve and value what he has instead of preparing for death. She departed by transforming into a harpy-like figure with enormous black wings.

log.summary: Vecna does not speak her name, but describes a woman Sylan should now understand who vied for complete undeath. Other gods saw that grab and stopped her, so it did not end as she wanted. She holds death, the vague moment in between, not undeath. Undead are not passed back through death; they are returned to where they were found, so she has no claim on them. If they passed through death again, they would move through her domain.
